testcase.name: Scenario: Restore distinct views of one part after switching windows: tmp/obk-window-views-source/features/application/document-tabs/document-tabs.feature:426:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Restore distinct views of one part after switching windows ✔ Given two numbered windows of the same part are open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the first window displays the sketch in an orthogonal view ✔ And the second window displays the part in an isometric view ✔ And the first window is active ✔ When the user switches to the second window through Home ✔ Then the second window displays its isometric view ✔ And the part's model browser is displayed ✔ When the user switches back to the first window through Home ✔ Then the first window displays its orthogonal sketch view ✔ And its sketch editing environment remains active
